In recent Hyprland versions these act as **setters**, forcing every window to 100% opaque — overriding Ghostty's own `background-opacity = 0.75`. This config was probably added when you migrated to the Lua config format, and the auto-generated template included them with 1.0 as a safe default that quietly kills app-level transparency.

Done. Reload Hyprland to apply it:

```

```

-- ============================================================
--  keybinds.lua  —  Omarchy's keymap, ported to Hyprland 0.55+ Lua
--
--  Grammar (Omarchy's, kept faithfully):
--    SUPER            = window & workspace management
--    SUPER + SHIFT    = launch apps  (and "relocate" on numbers/arrows)
--    SUPER + CTRL     = system / settings
--    SUPER + ALT      = a variant of the base action
--    CTRL + ALT       = session-level
--
--  Pruned to your setup: only terminal / browser / files / Obsidian
--  apps; Omarchy's own menu scripts swapped for standard Linux tools.
--
--  NOTE on hl.dsp.exec_raw("..."): several Omarchy actions use
--  dispatchers the typed Lua API hasn't wrapped yet (swapwindow,
--  movetoworkspacesilent, togglesplit, pin, centerwindow). exec_raw
--  runs the old-style dispatcher string verbatim — it's the bridge
--  for anything not yet in hl.dsp.*. If your build names it
--  differently, the error will point right at these lines.
--
--  Pull in from hyprland.lua with:  require("keybinds")
-- ============================================================

-- ---- Edit these to match your machine -----------------------
local vars = require("conf.vars")
local modKey = "SUPER"

-- ============================================================
--  APPLICATIONS  (SUPER + SHIFT = launch)
-- ============================================================
hl.bind(modKey .. " + RETURN",         hl.dsp.exec_cmd(vars.terminal))
hl.bind(modKey .. " + SPACE",          hl.dsp.exec_cmd(vars.launcher))
hl.bind(modKey .. " + B",      hl.dsp.exec_cmd(vars.browser))
hl.bind(modKey .. " + F",      hl.dsp.exec_cmd(vars.files))
hl.bind(modKey .. " + O",      hl.dsp.exec_cmd(vars.obsidian))
hl.bind(modKey .. " + A",      function()
  hl.exec_cmd(vars.browser)
  hl.exec_cmd(vars.terminal)
end)

---- Scroll -------------------------------------------------------
-- hl.bind("ALT + semicolon", hl.dsp.scroll({ direction = "down" }))
hl.bind("ALT + P", function() 
  hl.exec_cmd("move +col")
end)

-- ============================================================
--  WINDOW MANAGEMENT  (SUPER)
-- ============================================================
hl.bind(modKey .. " + Q", hl.dsp.window.close())                     -- close window
hl.bind(modKey .. " + D", hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" })) -- toggle float
hl.bind(modKey .. " + J", hl.dsp.exec_raw("togglesplit"))            -- flip split axis
hl.bind(modKey .. " + bracketright", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = 0 }))    -- fullscreen
hl.bind(modKey .. " + GRAVE", hl.dsp.layout("rotatesplit 90"))
-- (0.55 quirk: fullscreen toggle-off can misfire from a bind; works via hyprctl)

-- Pop out: float + size + center + pin  (Omarchy's SUPER+O)
hl.bind(modKey .. " + O", function()
  hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "set" }))

hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    -- Export Wayland env vars into the systemd user manager, then start the
    -- graphical session target so that WantedBy=graphical-session.target units
    -- (e.g. hyprwhspr) are activated automatically.
    -- hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("systemctl --user import-environment WAYLAND_DISPLAY DISPLAY XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP && systemctl --user start hyprland-session.service"))
    -- Start the yin wallpaper daemon first.
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("yin"))
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libexec/polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1"))
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("waybar"))
    -- Then apply the boot wallpaper once yin's IPC socket is ready. The wrapper
    -- waits for /tmp/yin instead of a fixed delay, so yinctl never races the daemon.
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("/home/krubics/.config/hypr/scripts/set-wallpaper.sh /home/krubics/.config/hypr/wallpapers/latios-latias.png"))
end)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fix Ghostty background transparency on Hyprland.
# GTK4 sends an opaque-region hint that causes Hyprland to skip per-pixel alpha
# blending, making the background appear solid. This script overrides that hint
# via `hyprctl setprop noopaqueregion` for every Ghostty window.

SOCKET="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hypr/$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE/.socket2.sock"

apply_fix() {
    hyprctl clients -j 2>/dev/null \
        | jq -r '.[] | select(.class == "com.mitchellh.ghostty") | .address' \
        | while read -r addr; do
            hyprctl setprop "address:$addr" noopaqueregion 1 2>/dev/null
          done
}

# Fix any Ghostty windows already open
apply_fix

# Watch for new windows and fix them as they open
socat - "UNIX-CONNECT:$SOCKET" 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r event; do
        [[ "$event" == openwindow\>* ]] && { sleep 0.05; apply_fix; }
      done

hl.monitor({
    output   = "",
    mode     = "preferred",
    position = "auto",
    scale    = "auto",
})

-------------------
---- AUTOSTART ----
-------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Autostart/

-- Autostart necessary processes (like notifications daemons, status bars, etc.)
-- Or execute your favorite apps at launch like this:
--
-- hl.on("hyprland.start", function () 
--   hl.exec_cmd(terminal)
--   hl.exec_cmd("nm-applet")
--   hl.exec_cmd("waybar & hyprpaper & firefox")
-- end)
hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    -- Export Wayland env vars into the systemd user manager, then start the
    -- graphical session target so that WantedBy=graphical-session.target units
    -- (e.g. hyprwhspr) are activated automatically.
    -- hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("systemctl --user import-environment WAYLAND_DISPLAY DISPLAY XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP && systemctl --user start hyprland-session.service"))
    -- Start the yin wallpaper daemon first.
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("yin"))
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libexec/polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1"))
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("waybar"))
    -- Then apply the boot wallpaper once yin's IPC socket is ready. The wrapper
    -- waits for /tmp/yin instead of a fixed delay, so yinctl never races the daemon.
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("/home/krubics/.config/hypr/scripts/set-wallpaper.sh /home/krubics/.config/hypr/wallpapers/latios-latias.png"))
end)
-------------------------------
---- ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES ----
-------------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Advanced-and-Cool/Environment-variables/

hl.env("XCURSOR_THEME", "Pokemon")
hl.env("XCURSOR_SIZE", "32")
hl.env("HYPRCURSOR_THEME", "Pokemon")
hl.env("HYPRCURSOR_SIZE", "24")


-- snapd exports its .desktop files here. Without this dir, waybar cannot map a
-- snap's window class to an app entry and renders no icon for it. The two
-- defaults must be spelled out: XDG_DATA_DIRS is otherwise unset, and glib's
-- implicit fallback to /usr/local/share:/usr/share is lost once we set it.
hl.env("XDG_DATA_DIRS", "/var/lib/snapd/desktop:/usr/local/share:/usr/share")

hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
  hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("hyprctl setcursor Pokemon 32"))
end)

Clean — no leftover opacity rule. Now apply:

```sh
hyprctl reload
```

The script will start at Hyprland launch (and persist across `hyprctl reload`s since it runs as an independent process). It does two things:
- Immediately fixes any already-open Ghostty windows via `hyprctl setprop ... noopaqueregion 1`
- Watches the Hyprland socket for new window events and fixes each new Ghostty window as it opens

This gives you what `opacity = "0.75 override"` couldn't: per-pixel alpha — transparent background, crisp text.
